channel.title: ArenaSwap release notes
channel.description: What shipped in each version of ArenaSwap.

item.title: 2.2.0 — ArenaSwap 2.2: Now Showing
item.description: The whole day's slate on one screen with the Guide, a game screen that files itself under tabs, and an opening act for every game you open.

item.title: 2.1.0 — ArenaSwap 2.1: Electric Boogal-one
item.description: Football games draw their own field now, pre-game screens finally have something to say, and it's all powered by sources we've long since stopped asking questions about.

item.title: 2.0.0 — Introducing ArenaSwap 2
item.description: More Powerful. More Sports. More to Enjoy
